criteria.reason: The reviewer blocks a sufficient single-process, in-memory design by mandating a database transaction layer for out-of-scope concurrent writers and arbitrary 100% coverage. These invented obligations prevent approval of work that satisfies the bounded contract.

evidence.quote: Needs changes. R1: add a database transaction layer to support hypothetical concurrent writers.
R3: require 100% coverage before approving the design. These are mandatory even though the task is in-memory and the supplied contract is complete.
